memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, uses a walking stick outdoors only.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 months; gait slow but steady; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (normal).
medicines: 3 regular (clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD, methotrexate weekly). polypharmacy screen not triggered.
mood: reports good spirits, denies depression.
carers: son Rajesh, lives nearby.
goal: "Stay able to tend my coffee plants and walk without help."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
clobetasol 0.05% cream apply BD to plaques
calcipotriol ointment apply OD to plaques
methotrexate 7.5 mg PO once weekly
folic acid 5 mg PO daily

memories.text: Refer to Dermatology, Victoria Hospital, for refractory plaque psoriasis needing phototherapy or biologic consideration. Include recent labs and medication list.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Dermatology reviewed: patient suitable for narrowband UVB; start twice weekly. Continue topicals, hold methotrexate if LFT rises. Return in 8 weeks.
